docs: Local audio/video transcription via whisper.cpp (Metal-accelerated on macOS). No npm dependency — the binary and model weights are provisioned outside npm and probed, not assumed.

installProbe.description: which(1) lookup for whisper-cli/whisper-cpp/main on PATH, falling back to a cached binary at <runtimeDir>/bin/whisper-cli.

healthCheck.description: whisper.cpp CLI has no --version flag; health runs the binary with --help and treats a clean exit (or the expected usage banner) as healthy. A missing binary or non-zero exit is unhealthy.

chain.description: No transcription backend available; audio/video ingest fails loud (ASR_REQUIRED) with an install hint (brew install whisper-cpp).
